# Step 4b: robustness of the communication patterns to input/parameter
# perturbations, for either pipeline:
#   main    = package default (prepare_input_files: quanTIseq + NNLS profiles + OmniPath)
#   curated = original RaCInG curated cell-type compatibility (see 01b)
# Every perturbed run rebuilds the RaCInG inputs end-to-end and recomputes the
# kernel networks, then is compared with the baseline at three levels:
# cohort-level patterns, patient-level networks and patient groupings.
# Usage: Rscript 04b_perturbations.R <work_dir> <main|curated> [n_rep=20] [ncores=6]
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
work_dir <- normalizePath(args[1])
pipeline <- args[2]
n_rep  <- if (length(args) >= 3) as.integer(args[3]) else 20
ncores <- if (length(args) >= 4) as.integer(args[4]) else 6
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "pattern_functions.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers_curated.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(parallel); library(mclust); library(ggplot2); library(pheatmap) })

res <- file.path(work_dir, "results")
paths <- switch(pipeline,
  main    = list(kernel = file.path(res, "02_kernel", "kernel_results.rds"),
                 patterns = file.path(res, "03_patterns", "patient_patterns.rds")),
  curated = list(kernel = file.path(res, "02b_kernel_curated_prior", "kernel_results.rds"),
                 patterns = file.path(res, "03b_patterns_curated_prior", "patient_patterns.rds")))
out_dir <- file.path(res, "04_robustness", paste0("perturbations_", pipeline))
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
scratch <- file.path(tempdir(), "racing_variants"); dir.create(scratch, showWarnings = FALSE)

base_k   <- readRDS(paths$kernel)
base_pat <- readRDS(paths$patterns)
base <- list(prob = base_k$dir_prob, enr = base_k$dir_norm,
             C = `rownames<-`(base_k$Cmatrix, to_original_id(rownames(base_k$Cmatrix))))
best_k <- base_pat$best_k
base_clusters <- base_pat$clusters
base_pc1 <- prcomp(base_pat$X)$x[, 1]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
network_from_input <- function(input) {
  kr <- compute_kernel(input$Lmatrix, input$Rmatrix, input$Cmatrix, input$LRmatrix, normalize = TRUE)
  cts <- input$celltypes
  prob <- directed_edge_probs(kr$kernel, input$Cmatrix, cts)
  enr <- compute_kernel_features(kr$kernel, unifKernel = kr$kernel_norm, celltypes = cts,
                                 communication_type = "D", bundle = FALSE, norm = TRUE,
                                 patient_names = rownames(prob), zero_threshold = 1.01)
  colnames(enr) <- sub("^Dir_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$", "\\1->\\2", colnames(enr))
  C <- input$Cmatrix; rownames(C) <- to_original_id(rownames(C))
  list(prob = prob, enr = as.matrix(enr[, colnames(prob)]), C = C)
}

pattern_sets <- function(net) {
  s <- summarise_edges(net$prob, net$enr, top_n = 10, present = edge_presence(net$C, colnames(net$prob)))
  het <- s[s$sender != s$receiver, ]
  list(summary = s,
       dominant = head(s$edge[order(-s$median_prob)], 10),
       dominant_hetero = head(het$edge[order(-het$median_prob)], 10),
       enriched = s$edge[s$frac_enriched_present >= 0.75 & s$n_present >= 20])
}
base_sets <- pattern_sets(base)

jaccard <- function(a, b) if (length(union(a, b)) == 0) NA else length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
med_rho <- function(A, B, margin) {
  v <- if (margin == 1) sapply(seq_len(nrow(A)), function(i) cor(A[i, ], B[i, ], method = "spearman"))
       else sapply(seq_len(ncol(A)), function(j) suppressWarnings(cor(A[, j], B[, j], method = "spearman")))
  median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
}

compare_to_base <- function(net, id, type) {
  pats <- intersect(rownames(net$prob), rownames(base$prob))
  edges <- intersect(colnames(net$prob), colnames(base$prob))
  sets <- pattern_sets(net)
  sv <- sets$summary[match(edges, sets$summary$edge), ]
  sb <- base_sets$summary[match(edges, base_sets$summary$edge), ]
  X <- enrichment_matrix(net$enr[pats, edges])
  cc <- consensus_cluster(X, ks = best_k, reps = 100, p_item = 0.8)
  cl <- cc$clusters[[as.character(best_k)]]
  bc <- base_clusters[pats]
  # clusterwise stability (Hennig 2007): best Jaccard match per baseline cluster
  cw <- sapply(sort(unique(base_clusters)), function(c) {
    a <- names(bc)[bc == c]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cl), function(d) jaccard(a, names(cl)[cl == d])))
  })
  metrics <- data.frame(
    run = id, perturbation = type, n_patients = length(pats), n_edges = length(edges),
    n_celltypes = length(unique(split_edge(colnames(net$prob))[, 1])),
    cohort_rho_prob = cor(sv$median_prob, sb$median_prob, method = "spearman"),
    cohort_rho_enrichment = cor(sv$median_enrichment, sb$median_enrichment, method = "spearman"),
    top10_dominant_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant, base_sets$dominant)) / 10,
    top10_dominant_hetero_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant_hetero, base_sets$dominant_hetero)) / 10,
    enriched_set_jaccard = jaccard(sets$enriched, base_sets$enriched),
    patient_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 1),
    patient_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 1),
    edge_across_patients_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 2),
    edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 2),
    pattern_ARI = adjustedRandIndex(cl, bc),
    PC1_abs_rho = abs(cor(prcomp(X)$x[, 1], base_pc1[pats], method = "spearman"))
  )
  for (c in seq_along(cw)) metrics[[paste0("jaccard_P", c)]] <- cw[c]
  list(metrics = metrics, dominant = sets$dominant, dominant_hetero = sets$dominant_hetero,
       enriched = sets$enriched)
}

add_noise_expr <- function(tpm, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lg <- log2(tpm + 1) + matrix(rnorm(length(tpm), 0, sd), nrow(tpm))
  t2 <- 2^pmax(lg, 0) - 1
  t2 <- sweep(t2, 2, colSums(t2), "/") * 1e6
  dimnames(t2) <- dimnames(tpm); t2
}
add_noise_frac <- function(f, sdlog, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  f2 <- as.matrix(f) * exp(matrix(rnorm(length(as.matrix(f)), 0, sdlog), nrow(f)))
  f2 <- f2 / rowSums(f2)
  if (is.data.frame(f)) f2 <- as.data.frame(f2)
  f2
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ variants
tpm <- load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = TRUE)
jobs <- list()
reps <- seq_len(n_rep)

if (pipeline == "main") {
  deconv <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  omni <- readRDS(file.path(tools::R_user_dir("RaCInG", "cache"), "curated_omni_network.rds"))
  bi <- function(id, t, d, ...) { o <- file.path(scratch, id); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE)); build_inputs(t, d, o, ...) }
  jobs[["expr_threshold_5"]]  <- list(type = "expr_threshold = 5 TPM", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, expr_threshold = 5))
  jobs[["expr_threshold_20"]] <- list(type = "expr_threshold = 20 TPM", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, expr_threshold = 20))
  jobs[["fun_LR_prod"]]       <- list(type = "fun_LR = prod", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, fun_LR = prod))
  jobs[["no_TPM_rescaling"]]  <- list(type = "no TPM re-closure", f = function(id) bi(id, load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = FALSE), deconv))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]]    <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) {
    keep <- setdiff(colnames(tpm), "Pt8_PD1_PRE"); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      bi(id, tpm, add_noise_frac(deconv, 0.3, 100 + r)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      bi(id, t2, run_quantiseq(t2, o)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); bi(id, tpm, deconv, cc_network = omni[sort(sample(nrow(omni), round(0.8 * nrow(omni)))), ]) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); keep <- sort(sample(colnames(tpm), round(0.8 * ncol(tpm)))); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  }
} else {
  prior <- curated_prior()
  q <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  epic <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01b_curated_prior_inputs", "epic_fractions.rds"))
  base_input <- build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic)
  subset_input <- function(inp, keep) { i <- match(keep, rownames(inp$Cmatrix))
    inp$Cmatrix <- inp$Cmatrix[i, , drop = FALSE]; inp$LRmatrix <- inp$LRmatrix[, , i, drop = FALSE]; inp }
  jobs[["tumor_as_quantiseq_other"]] <- list(type = "Tumor = quanTIseq other", f = function(id) build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, tumor_mode = "other"))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]] <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) subset_input(base_input, setdiff(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), "Pt8_PD1_PRE")))
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      inp <- base_input; inp$Cmatrix <- add_noise_frac(inp$Cmatrix, 0.3, 100 + r); inp })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      q2 <- run_quantiseq(t2, o); build_curated_input(prior, t2, q2, run_epic(t2)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, keep_pairs = sort(sample(nrow(prior$pairs), round(0.8 * nrow(prior$pairs))))) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); subset_input(base_input, sort(sample(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), round(0.8 * nrow(base_input$Cmatrix))))) })
  }
}

cat(length(jobs), "perturbed runs on", ncores, "cores\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
out <- mclapply(names(jobs), function(id) {
  j <- jobs[[id]]
  tryCatch({
    inp <- if (is.null(j$r)) j$f(id) else j$f(id, j$r)
    compare_to_base(network_from_input(inp), id, j$type)
  }, error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e), run = id))
}, mc.cores = ncores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
names(out) <- names(jobs)
cat("Finished in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")
failed <- vapply(out, function(o) !is.null(o$error), logical(1))
if (any(failed)) { cat("FAILED runs:\n"); print(sapply(out[failed], `[[`, "error")) }
out <- out[!failed]
saveRDS(out, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_runs.rds"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ summaries
metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(out, `[[`, "metrics"))
write.csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
num <- setdiff(names(metrics), c("run", "perturbation"))
summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(metrics, metrics$perturbation), function(d) {
  data.frame(perturbation = d$perturbation[1], n_runs = nrow(d),
             t(sapply(num, function(m) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f-%.2f]", median(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                min(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE), max(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE)))),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(summ, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# per-pattern retention: how often each baseline pattern survives a perturbation
retention <- function(field, base_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(out, sapply(out, function(o) o$metrics$perturbation)), function(runs) {
    data.frame(perturbation = runs[[1]]$metrics$perturbation, edge = base_list,
               retained = sapply(base_list, function(e) mean(sapply(runs, function(o) e %in% o[[field]]))))
  }))
}
ret <- rbind(cbind(set = "dominant (top 10 by probability)", retention("dominant", base_sets$dominant)),
             cbind(set = "dominant heterotypic (top 10)", retention("dominant_hetero", base_sets$dominant_hetero)),
             cbind(set = "commonly enriched (>=75% of patients)", retention("enriched", base_sets$enriched)))
write.csv(ret, file.path(out_dir, "pattern_retention.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (s in unique(ret$set)) {
  d <- ret[ret$set == s, ]
  m <- tapply(d$retained, list(d$edge, d$perturbation), mean)
  m <- m[order(-rowMeans(m)), , drop = FALSE]
  pheatmap(100 * m, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f",
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(100), breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
           main = paste0("% of perturbed runs retaining baseline pattern: ", s), angle_col = 45,
           filename = file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("retention_%s.pdf", gsub("[^a-z]+", "_", tolower(s)))),
           width = 8, height = 0.3 * nrow(m) + 2.5)
}

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_prob",
                                "patient_rho_enrichment", "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment",
                                "enriched_set_jaccard", "top10_dominant_hetero_overlap", "pattern_ARI"),
  function(m) data.frame(metric = m, perturbation = metrics$perturbation, value = metrics[[m]])))
g <- ggplot(long, aes(x = perturbation, y = value)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) + facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(0, min(long$value, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = sprintf("Agreement with baseline (%s pipeline)", pipeline)) +
  theme_bw(9) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "agreement_with_baseline.pdf"), g, width = 13, height = 7)

# cohort-level patient bootstrap of the baseline (sampling uncertainty of the
# cohort summaries, independent of input perturbations)
set.seed(7)
B <- 1000
boot <- replicate(B, {
  idx <- sample(nrow(base$prob), replace = TRUE)
  nb <- list(prob = base$prob[idx, ], enr = base$enr[idx, ], C = base$C[idx, ])
  rownames(nb$prob) <- rownames(nb$enr) <- rownames(nb$C) <- paste0("b", seq_along(idx))
  s <- pattern_sets(nb)
  c(dominant = list(s$dominant), enriched = list(s$enriched),
    med = list(setNames(s$summary$median_prob, s$summary$edge)),
    fenr = list(setNames(s$summary$frac_enriched_present, s$summary$edge)))
}, simplify = FALSE)
edges_all <- colnames(base$prob)
bt <- data.frame(edge = edges_all,
  p_dominant_top10 = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$dominant))),
  p_commonly_enriched = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$enriched))),
  median_prob_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.025)),
  median_prob_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.975)),
  frac_enriched_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
  frac_enriched_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
  row.names = NULL)
bt <- merge(base_sets$summary[, c("edge", "median_prob", "frac_enriched_present", "n_present")], bt, by = "edge")
bt <- bt[order(-bt$p_dominant_top10, -bt$p_commonly_enriched), ]
write.csv(bt, file.path(out_dir, "edge_bootstrap_cohort.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(summ[, c("perturbation", "n_runs", "cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_enrichment",
               "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment", "enriched_set_jaccard", "pattern_ARI")], right = FALSE)

base_sets <- pattern_sets(base)

jaccard <- function(a, b) if (length(union(a, b)) == 0) NA else length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
med_rho <- function(A, B, margin) {
  v <- if (margin == 1) sapply(seq_len(nrow(A)), function(i) cor(A[i, ], B[i, ], method = "spearman"))

compare_to_base <- function(net, id, type) {
  pats <- intersect(rownames(net$prob), rownames(base$prob))
  edges <- intersect(colnames(net$prob), colnames(base$prob))
  sets <- pattern_sets(net)
  sv <- sets$summary[match(edges, sets$summary$edge), ]
  sb <- base_sets$summary[match(edges, base_sets$summary$edge), ]
  X <- enrichment_matrix(net$enr[pats, edges])
  cc <- consensus_cluster(X, ks = best_k, reps = 100, p_item = 0.8)
  cl <- cc$clusters[[as.character(best_k)]]
  bc <- base_clusters[pats]
  # clusterwise stability (Hennig 2007): best Jaccard match per baseline cluster
  cw <- sapply(sort(unique(base_clusters)), function(c) {
    a <- names(bc)[bc == c]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cl), function(d) jaccard(a, names(cl)[cl == d])))
  })
  metrics <- data.frame(
    run = id, perturbation = type, n_patients = length(pats), n_edges = length(edges),
    n_celltypes = length(unique(split_edge(colnames(net$prob))[, 1])),
    cohort_rho_prob = cor(sv$median_prob, sb$median_prob, method = "spearman"),
    cohort_rho_enrichment = cor(sv$median_enrichment, sb$median_enrichment, method = "spearman"),
    top10_dominant_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant, base_sets$dominant)) / 10,
    top10_dominant_hetero_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant_hetero, base_sets$dominant_hetero)) / 10,
    enriched_set_jaccard = jaccard(sets$enriched, base_sets$enriched),
    patient_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 1),
    patient_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 1),
    edge_across_patients_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 2),
    edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 2),
    pattern_ARI = adjustedRandIndex(cl, bc),
    PC1_abs_rho = abs(cor(prcomp(X)$x[, 1], base_pc1[pats], method = "spearman"))
  )
  for (c in seq_along(cw)) metrics[[paste0("jaccard_P", c)]] <- cw[c]
  list(metrics = metrics, dominant = sets$dominant, dominant_hetero = sets$dominant_hetero,
       enriched = sets$enriched)
}

add_noise_expr <- function(tpm, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lg <- log2(tpm + 1) + matrix(rnorm(length(tpm), 0, sd), nrow(tpm))
  t2 <- 2^pmax(lg, 0) - 1
  t2 <- sweep(t2, 2, colSums(t2), "/") * 1e6
  dimnames(t2) <- dimnames(tpm); t2
}
add_noise_frac <- function(f, sdlog, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  f2 <- as.matrix(f) * exp(matrix(rnorm(length(as.matrix(f)), 0, sdlog), nrow(f)))
  f2 <- f2 / rowSums(f2)
  if (is.data.frame(f)) f2 <- as.data.frame(f2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ variants
tpm <- load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = TRUE)
jobs <- list()
reps <- seq_len(n_rep)

if (pipeline == "main") {
  deconv <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))

} else {

    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {

      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      bi(id, t2, run_quantiseq(t2, o)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); bi(id, tpm, deconv, cc_network = omni[sort(sample(nrow(omni), round(0.8 * nrow(omni)))), ]) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); keep <- sort(sample(colnames(tpm), round(0.8 * ncol(tpm)))); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  }
} else {
  prior <- curated_prior()
  q <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  epic <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01b_curated_prior_inputs", "epic_fractions.rds"))
  base_input <- build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic)
  subset_input <- function(inp, keep) { i <- match(keep, rownames(inp$Cmatrix))
    inp$Cmatrix <- inp$Cmatrix[i, , drop = FALSE]; inp$LRmatrix <- inp$LRmatrix[, , i, drop = FALSE]; inp }
  jobs[["tumor_as_quantiseq_other"]] <- list(type = "Tumor = quanTIseq other", f = function(id) build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, tumor_mode = "other"))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]] <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) subset_input(base_input, setdiff(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), "Pt8_PD1_PRE")))
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      inp <- base_input; inp$Cmatrix <- add_noise_frac(inp$Cmatrix, 0.3, 100 + r); inp })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      q2 <- run_quantiseq(t2, o); build_curated_input(prior, t2, q2, run_epic(t2)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, keep_pairs = sort(sample(nrow(prior$pairs), round(0.8 * nrow(prior$pairs))))) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); subset_input(base_input, sort(sample(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), round(0.8 * nrow(base_input$Cmatrix))))) })
  }
}

cat(length(jobs), "perturbed runs on", ncores, "cores\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
out <- mclapply(names(jobs), function(id) {
  j <- jobs[[id]]
  tryCatch({
    inp <- if (is.null(j$r)) j$f(id) else j$f(id, j$r)
    compare_to_base(network_from_input(inp), id, j$type)
  }, error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e), run = id))
}, mc.cores = ncores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
names(out) <- names(jobs)
cat("Finished in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")
failed <- vapply(out, function(o) !is.null(o$error), logical(1))
if (any(failed)) { cat("FAILED runs:\n"); print(sapply(out[failed], `[[`, "error")) }
out <- out[!failed]
saveRDS(out, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_runs.rds"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ summaries
metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(out, `[[`, "metrics"))
write.csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
num <- setdiff(names(metrics), c("run", "perturbation"))
summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(metrics, metrics$perturbation), function(d) {
  data.frame(perturbation = d$perturbation[1], n_runs = nrow(d),
             t(sapply(num, function(m) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f-%.2f]", median(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                min(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE), max(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE)))),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(summ, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# per-pattern retention: how often each baseline pattern survives a perturbation
retention <- function(field, base_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(out, sapply(out, function(o) o$metrics$perturbation)), function(runs) {
    data.frame(perturbation = runs[[1]]$metrics$perturbation, edge = base_list,
               retained = sapply(base_list, function(e) mean(sapply(runs, function(o) e %in% o[[field]]))))
  }))
}
ret <- rbind(cbind(set = "dominant (top 10 by probability)", retention("dominant", base_sets$dominant)),
             cbind(set = "dominant heterotypic (top 10)", retention("dominant_hetero", base_sets$dominant_hetero)),
             cbind(set = "commonly enriched (>=75% of patients)", retention("enriched", base_sets$enriched)))
write.csv(ret, file.path(out_dir, "pattern_retention.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (s in unique(ret$set)) {
  d <- ret[ret$set == s, ]
  m <- tapply(d$retained, list(d$edge, d$perturbation), mean)
  m <- m[order(-rowMeans(m)), , drop = FALSE]
  pheatmap(100 * m, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f",
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(100), breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
           main = paste0("% of perturbed runs retaining baseline pattern: ", s), angle_col = 45,
           filename = file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("retention_%s.pdf", gsub("[^a-z]+", "_", tolower(s)))),
           width = 8, height = 0.3 * nrow(m) + 2.5)
}

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_prob",
                                "patient_rho_enrichment", "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment",
                                "enriched_set_jaccard", "top10_dominant_hetero_overlap", "pattern_ARI"),
  function(m) data.frame(metric = m, perturbation = metrics$perturbation, value = metrics[[m]])))
g <- ggplot(long, aes(x = perturbation, y = value)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) + facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(0, min(long$value, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = sprintf("Agreement with baseline (%s pipeline)", pipeline)) +
  theme_bw(9) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "agreement_with_baseline.pdf"), g, width = 13, height = 7)

# cohort-level patient bootstrap of the baseline (sampling uncertainty of the
# cohort summaries, independent of input perturbations)
set.seed(7)
B <- 1000
boot <- replicate(B, {
  idx <- sample(nrow(base$prob), replace = TRUE)
  nb <- list(prob = base$prob[idx, ], enr = base$enr[idx, ], C = base$C[idx, ])
  rownames(nb$prob) <- rownames(nb$enr) <- rownames(nb$C) <- paste0("b", seq_along(idx))
  s <- pattern_sets(nb)
  c(dominant = list(s$dominant), enriched = list(s$enriched),
    med = list(setNames(s$summary$median_prob, s$summary$edge)),
    fenr = list(setNames(s$summary$frac_enriched_present, s$summary$edge)))
}, simplify = FALSE)
edges_all <- colnames(base$prob)
bt <- data.frame(edge = edges_all,
  p_dominant_top10 = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$dominant))),
  p_commonly_enriched = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$enriched))),
  median_prob_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.025)),
  median_prob_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.975)),
  frac_enriched_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
  frac_enriched_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
  row.names = NULL)
bt <- merge(base_sets$summary[, c("edge", "median_prob", "frac_enriched_present", "n_present")], bt, by = "edge")
bt <- bt[order(-bt$p_dominant_top10, -bt$p_commonly_enriched), ]
write.csv(bt, file.path(out_dir, "edge_bootstrap_cohort.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(summ[, c("perturbation", "n_runs", "cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_enrichment",
               "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment", "enriched_set_jaccard", "pattern_ARI")], right = FALSE)

# Step 4b: robustness of the communication patterns to input/parameter
# perturbations, for either pipeline:
#   main    = package default (prepare_input_files: quanTIseq + NNLS profiles + OmniPath)
#   curated = original RaCInG curated cell-type compatibility (see 01b)
# Every perturbed run rebuilds the RaCInG inputs end-to-end and recomputes the
# kernel networks, then is compared with the baseline at three levels:
# cohort-level patterns, patient-level networks and patient groupings.
# Usage: Rscript 04b_perturbations.R <work_dir> <main|curated> [n_rep=20] [ncores=6]
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
work_dir <- normalizePath(args[1])
pipeline <- args[2]
n_rep  <- if (length(args) >= 3) as.integer(args[3]) else 20
ncores <- if (length(args) >= 4) as.integer(args[4]) else 6
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "pattern_functions.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers_curated.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(parallel); library(mclust); library(ggplot2); library(pheatmap) })

res <- file.path(work_dir, "results")
paths <- switch(pipeline,
  main    = list(kernel = file.path(res, "02_kernel", "kernel_results.rds"),
                 patterns = file.path(res, "03_patterns", "patient_patterns.rds")),
  curated = list(kernel = file.path(res, "02b_kernel_curated_prior", "kernel_results.rds"),
                 patterns = file.path(res, "03b_patterns_curated_prior", "patient_patterns.rds")))
out_dir <- file.path(res, "04_robustness", paste0("perturbations_", pipeline))
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
scratch <- file.path(tempdir(), "racing_variants"); dir.create(scratch, showWarnings = FALSE)

base_k   <- readRDS(paths$kernel)
base_pat <- readRDS(paths$patterns)
base <- list(prob = base_k$dir_prob, enr = base_k$dir_norm,
             C = `rownames<-`(base_k$Cmatrix, to_original_id(rownames(base_k$Cmatrix))))
best_k <- base_pat$best_k
base_clusters <- base_pat$clusters
base_pc1 <- prcomp(base_pat$X)$x[, 1]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
network_from_input <- function(input) {
  kr <- compute_kernel(input$Lmatrix, input$Rmatrix, input$Cmatrix, input$LRmatrix, normalize = TRUE)
  cts <- input$celltypes
  prob <- directed_edge_probs(kr$kernel, input$Cmatrix, cts)
  enr <- compute_kernel_features(kr$kernel, unifKernel = kr$kernel_norm, celltypes = cts,
                                 communication_type = "D", bundle = FALSE, norm = TRUE,
                                 patient_names = rownames(prob), zero_threshold = 1.01)
  colnames(enr) <- sub("^Dir_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$", "\\1->\\2", colnames(enr))
  C <- input$Cmatrix; rownames(C) <- to_original_id(rownames(C))
  list(prob = prob, enr = as.matrix(enr[, colnames(prob)]), C = C)
}

pattern_sets <- function(net) {
  s <- summarise_edges(net$prob, net$enr, top_n = 10, present = edge_presence(net$C, colnames(net$prob)))
  het <- s[s$sender != s$receiver, ]
  list(summary = s,
       dominant = head(s$edge[order(-s$median_prob)], 10),
       dominant_hetero = head(het$edge[order(-het$median_prob)], 10),
       enriched = s$edge[s$frac_enriched_present >= 0.75 & s$n_present >= 20])
}
base_sets <- pattern_sets(base)

jaccard <- function(a, b) if (length(union(a, b)) == 0) NA else length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
med_rho <- function(A, B, margin) {
  v <- if (margin == 1) sapply(seq_len(nrow(A)), function(i) cor(A[i, ], B[i, ], method = "spearman"))
       else sapply(seq_len(ncol(A)), function(j) suppressWarnings(cor(A[, j], B[, j], method = "spearman")))
  median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
}

compare_to_base <- function(net, id, type) {
  pats <- intersect(rownames(net$prob), rownames(base$prob))
  edges <- intersect(colnames(net$prob), colnames(base$prob))
  sets <- pattern_sets(net)
  sv <- sets$summary[match(edges, sets$summary$edge), ]
  sb <- base_sets$summary[match(edges, base_sets$summary$edge), ]
  X <- enrichment_matrix(net$enr[pats, edges])
  cc <- consensus_cluster(X, ks = best_k, reps = 100, p_item = 0.8)
  cl <- cc$clusters[[as.character(best_k)]]
  bc <- base_clusters[pats]
  # clusterwise stability (Hennig 2007): best Jaccard match per baseline cluster
  cw <- sapply(sort(unique(base_clusters)), function(c) {
    a <- names(bc)[bc == c]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cl), function(d) jaccard(a, names(cl)[cl == d])))
  })
  metrics <- data.frame(
    run = id, perturbation = type, n_patients = length(pats), n_edges = length(edges),
    n_celltypes = length(unique(split_edge(colnames(net$prob))[, 1])),
    cohort_rho_prob = cor(sv$median_prob, sb$median_prob, method = "spearman"),
    cohort_rho_enrichment = cor(sv$median_enrichment, sb$median_enrichment, method = "spearman"),
    top10_dominant_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant, base_sets$dominant)) / 10,
    top10_dominant_hetero_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant_hetero, base_sets$dominant_hetero)) / 10,
    enriched_set_jaccard = jaccard(sets$enriched, base_sets$enriched),
    patient_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 1),
    patient_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 1),
    edge_across_patients_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 2),
    edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 2),
    pattern_ARI = adjustedRandIndex(cl, bc),
    PC1_abs_rho = abs(cor(prcomp(X)$x[, 1], base_pc1[pats], method = "spearman"))
  )
  for (c in seq_along(cw)) metrics[[paste0("jaccard_P", c)]] <- cw[c]
  list(metrics = metrics, dominant = sets$dominant, dominant_hetero = sets$dominant_hetero,
       enriched = sets$enriched)
}

add_noise_expr <- function(tpm, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lg <- log2(tpm + 1) + matrix(rnorm(length(tpm), 0, sd), nrow(tpm))
  t2 <- 2^pmax(lg, 0) - 1
  t2 <- sweep(t2, 2, colSums(t2), "/") * 1e6
  dimnames(t2) <- dimnames(tpm); t2
}
add_noise_frac <- function(f, sdlog, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  f2 <- as.matrix(f) * exp(matrix(rnorm(length(as.matrix(f)), 0, sdlog), nrow(f)))
  f2 <- f2 / rowSums(f2)
  if (is.data.frame(f)) f2 <- as.data.frame(f2)
  f2
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ variants
tpm <- load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = TRUE)
jobs <- list()
reps <- seq_len(n_rep)

if (pipeline == "main") {
  deconv <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  omni <- readRDS(file.path(tools::R_user_dir("RaCInG", "cache"), "curated_omni_network.rds"))
  bi <- function(id, t, d, ...) { o <- file.path(scratch, id); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE)); build_inputs(t, d, o, ...) }
  jobs[["expr_threshold_5"]]  <- list(type = "expr_threshold = 5 TPM", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, expr_threshold = 5))
  jobs[["expr_threshold_20"]] <- list(type = "expr_threshold = 20 TPM", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, expr_threshold = 20))
  jobs[["fun_LR_prod"]]       <- list(type = "fun_LR = prod", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, fun_LR = prod))
  jobs[["no_TPM_rescaling"]]  <- list(type = "no TPM re-closure", f = function(id) bi(id, load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = FALSE), deconv))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]]    <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) {
    keep <- setdiff(colnames(tpm), "Pt8_PD1_PRE"); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      bi(id, tpm, add_noise_frac(deconv, 0.3, 100 + r)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      bi(id, t2, run_quantiseq(t2, o)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); bi(id, tpm, deconv, cc_network = omni[sort(sample(nrow(omni), round(0.8 * nrow(omni)))), ]) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); keep <- sort(sample(colnames(tpm), round(0.8 * ncol(tpm)))); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  }
} else {
  prior <- curated_prior()
  q <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  epic <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01b_curated_prior_inputs", "epic_fractions.rds"))
  base_input <- build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic)
  subset_input <- function(inp, keep) { i <- match(keep, rownames(inp$Cmatrix))
    inp$Cmatrix <- inp$Cmatrix[i, , drop = FALSE]; inp$LRmatrix <- inp$LRmatrix[, , i, drop = FALSE]; inp }
  jobs[["tumor_as_quantiseq_other"]] <- list(type = "Tumor = quanTIseq other", f = function(id) build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, tumor_mode = "other"))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]] <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) subset_input(base_input, setdiff(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), "Pt8_PD1_PRE")))
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      inp <- base_input; inp$Cmatrix <- add_noise_frac(inp$Cmatrix, 0.3, 100 + r); inp })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      q2 <- run_quantiseq(t2, o); build_curated_input(prior, t2, q2, run_epic(t2)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, keep_pairs = sort(sample(nrow(prior$pairs), round(0.8 * nrow(prior$pairs))))) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); subset_input(base_input, sort(sample(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), round(0.8 * nrow(base_input$Cmatrix))))) })
  }
}

cat(length(jobs), "perturbed runs on", ncores, "cores\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
out <- mclapply(names(jobs), function(id) {
  j <- jobs[[id]]
  tryCatch({
    inp <- if (is.null(j$r)) j$f(id) else j$f(id, j$r)
    compare_to_base(network_from_input(inp), id, j$type)
  }, error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e), run = id))
}, mc.cores = ncores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
names(out) <- names(jobs)
cat("Finished in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")
failed <- vapply(out, function(o) !is.null(o$error), logical(1))
if (any(failed)) { cat("FAILED runs:\n"); print(sapply(out[failed], `[[`, "error")) }
out <- out[!failed]
saveRDS(out, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_runs.rds"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ summaries
metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(out, `[[`, "metrics"))
write.csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
num <- setdiff(names(metrics), c("run", "perturbation"))
summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(metrics, metrics$perturbation), function(d) {
  data.frame(perturbation = d$perturbation[1], n_runs = nrow(d),
             t(sapply(num, function(m) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f-%.2f]", median(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                min(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE), max(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE)))),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(summ, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# per-pattern retention: how often each baseline pattern survives a perturbation
retention <- function(field, base_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(out, sapply(out, function(o) o$metrics$perturbation)), function(runs) {
    data.frame(perturbation = runs[[1]]$metrics$perturbation, edge = base_list,
               retained = sapply(base_list, function(e) mean(sapply(runs, function(o) e %in% o[[field]]))))
  }))
}
ret <- rbind(cbind(set = "dominant (top 10 by probability)", retention("dominant", base_sets$dominant)),
             cbind(set = "dominant heterotypic (top 10)", retention("dominant_hetero", base_sets$dominant_hetero)),
             cbind(set = "commonly enriched (>=75% of patients)", retention("enriched", base_sets$enriched)))
write.csv(ret, file.path(out_dir, "pattern_retention.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (s in unique(ret$set)) {
  d <- ret[ret$set == s, ]
  m <- tapply(d$retained, list(d$edge, d$perturbation), mean)
  m <- m[order(-rowMeans(m)), , drop = FALSE]
  pheatmap(100 * m, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f",
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(100), breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
           main = paste0("% of perturbed runs retaining baseline pattern: ", s), angle_col = 45,
           filename = file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("retention_%s.pdf", gsub("[^a-z]+", "_", tolower(s)))),
           width = 8, height = 0.3 * nrow(m) + 2.5)
}

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_prob",
                                "patient_rho_enrichment", "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment",
                                "enriched_set_jaccard", "top10_dominant_hetero_overlap", "pattern_ARI"),
  function(m) data.frame(metric = m, perturbation = metrics$perturbation, value = metrics[[m]])))
g <- ggplot(long, aes(x = perturbation, y = value)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) + facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(0, min(long$value, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = sprintf("Agreement with baseline (%s pipeline)", pipeline)) +
  theme_bw(9) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "agreement_with_baseline.pdf"), g, width = 13, height = 7)

# cohort-level patient bootstrap of the baseline (sampling uncertainty of the
# cohort summaries, independent of input perturbations)
set.seed(7)
B <- 1000
boot <- replicate(B, {
  idx <- sample(nrow(base$prob), replace = TRUE)
  nb <- list(prob = base$prob[idx, ], enr = base$enr[idx, ], C = base$C[idx, ])
  rownames(nb$prob) <- rownames(nb$enr) <- rownames(nb$C) <- paste0("b", seq_along(idx))
  s <- pattern_sets(nb)
  c(dominant = list(s$dominant), enriched = list(s$enriched),
    med = list(setNames(s$summary$median_prob, s$summary$edge)),
    fenr = list(setNames(s$summary$frac_enriched_present, s$summary$edge)))
}, simplify = FALSE)
edges_all <- colnames(base$prob)
bt <- data.frame(edge = edges_all,
  p_dominant_top10 = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$dominant))),
  p_commonly_enriched = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$enriched))),
  median_prob_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.025)),
  median_prob_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.975)),
  frac_enriched_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
  frac_enriched_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
  row.names = NULL)
bt <- merge(base_sets$summary[, c("edge", "median_prob", "frac_enriched_present", "n_present")], bt, by = "edge")
bt <- bt[order(-bt$p_dominant_top10, -bt$p_commonly_enriched), ]
write.csv(bt, file.path(out_dir, "edge_bootstrap_cohort.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(summ[, c("perturbation", "n_runs", "cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_enrichment",
               "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment", "enriched_set_jaccard", "pattern_ARI")], right = FALSE)

# Step 4c: concordance between the two cell-type compatibility priors
# (data-driven NNLS default vs curated original RaCInG) on the cell types they
# share. Main-pipeline M1 and M2 are merged into "Macrophage"; edges are
# merged at the kernel level (abundance-weighted sums of kernel entries), so
# merged enrichment = sum q_i q_j K_ij / sum q_i q_j U_ij over the group.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
work_dir <- normalizePath(if (length(args) >= 1) args[1] else ".")
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "pattern_functions.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2); library(mclust) })

res <- file.path(work_dir, "results")
out_dir <- file.path(res, "04_robustness", "prior_concordance")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

km <- readRDS(file.path(res, "02_kernel", "kernel_results.rds"))
kc <- readRDS(file.path(res, "02b_kernel_curated_prior", "kernel_results.rds"))
shared <- c("B", "CD8", "DC", "Macrophage", "NK", "Treg", "Tumor")
map_main <- c(B = "B", CD8 = "CD8", DC = "DC", M1 = "Macrophage", M2 = "Macrophage",
              NK = "NK", Treg = "Treg", Tumor = "Tumor")
map_cur  <- setNames(shared, shared)

merge_network <- function(k, map, eps = 1e-6) {
  cts <- k$celltypes
  grid <- expand.grid(sender = shared, receiver = shared, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  edges <- paste0(grid$sender, "->", grid$receiver)
  n_p <- nrow(k$Cmatrix)
  prob <- enr <- matrix(NA, n_p, length(edges), dimnames = list(k$patients, edges))
  pres <- matrix(FALSE, n_p, length(edges), dimnames = list(k$patients, edges))
  idx <- lapply(shared, function(g) which(cts %in% names(map)[map == g])); names(idx) <- shared
  for (p in seq_len(n_p)) {
    q <- k$Cmatrix[p, ]
    W  <- outer(q, q) * k$kernel[, , p]
    Wk <- outer(q + eps, q + eps) * k$kernel[, , p]
    Wu <- outer(q + eps, q + eps) * k$kernel_norm[, , p]
    for (e in seq_along(edges)) {
      a <- idx[[grid$sender[e]]]; b <- idx[[grid$receiver[e]]]
      prob[p, e] <- sum(W[a, b]); enr[p, e] <- sum(Wk[a, b]) / sum(Wu[a, b])
      pres[p, e] <- sum(q[a]) > 0 && sum(q[b]) > 0
    }
  }
  enr[!is.finite(enr)] <- 0
  list(prob = prob / rowSums(prob), enr = enr, present = pres)
}
nm <- merge_network(km, map_main)
nc <- merge_network(kc, map_cur)
pats <- intersect(rownames(nm$prob), rownames(nc$prob))
edges <- colnames(nm$prob)

sm <- summarise_edges(nm$prob[pats, ], nm$enr[pats, ], present = nm$present[pats, ])
sc <- summarise_edges(nc$prob[pats, ], nc$enr[pats, ], present = nc$present[pats, ])
sm <- sm[match(edges, sm$edge), ]; sc <- sc[match(edges, sc$edge), ]

per_edge <- data.frame(
  edge = edges, sender = sm$sender, receiver = sm$receiver,
  median_prob_default = sm$median_prob, median_prob_curated = sc$median_prob,
  median_enr_default = sm$median_enrichment, median_enr_curated = sc$median_enrichment,
  frac_enriched_default = sm$frac_enriched_present, frac_enriched_curated = sc$frac_enriched_present,
  rho_across_patients_prob = sapply(edges, function(e) suppressWarnings(cor(nm$prob[pats, e], nc$prob[pats, e], method = "spearman"))),
  rho_across_patients_enr = sapply(edges, function(e) suppressWarnings(cor(nm$enr[pats, e], nc$enr[pats, e], method = "spearman"))),
  row.names = NULL)
per_edge$enriched_in_both <- per_edge$frac_enriched_default >= 0.75 & per_edge$frac_enriched_curated >= 0.75
per_edge$depleted_in_both <- per_edge$frac_enriched_default <= 0.25 & per_edge$frac_enriched_curated <= 0.25
write.csv(per_edge, file.path(out_dir, "shared_edges_default_vs_curated.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

top10 <- function(s, het = FALSE) { if (het) s <- s[s$sender != s$receiver, ]; head(s$edge[order(-s$median_prob)], 10) }
en_set <- function(s) s$edge[s$frac_enriched_present >= 0.75 & s$n_present >= 20]
pm <- readRDS(file.path(res, "03_patterns", "patient_patterns.rds"))
pc <- readRDS(file.path(res, "03b_patterns_curated_prior", "patient_patterns.rds"))
summary_tab <- data.frame(
  metric = c("cohort Spearman, median probability (49 shared edges)",
             "cohort Spearman, median enrichment",
             "top-10 dominant edges overlap",
             "top-10 dominant heterotypic edges overlap",
             "commonly-enriched set Jaccard",
             "median per-patient Spearman (probability)",
             "median per-patient Spearman (enrichment)",
             "median per-edge across-patient Spearman (probability)",
             "median per-edge across-patient Spearman (enrichment)",
             "ARI of patient patterns (default k vs curated k)",
             "|Spearman| of enrichment PC1 scores"),
  value = c(cor(sm$median_prob, sc$median_prob, method = "spearman"),
            cor(sm$median_enrichment, sc$median_enrichment, method = "spearman"),
            length(intersect(top10(sm), top10(sc))) / 10,
            length(intersect(top10(sm, TRUE), top10(sc, TRUE))) / 10,
            length(intersect(en_set(sm), en_set(sc))) / length(union(en_set(sm), en_set(sc))),
            median(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(nm$prob[p, ], nc$prob[p, ], method = "spearman"))),
            median(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(nm$enr[p, ], nc$enr[p, ], method = "spearman"))),
            median(per_edge$rho_across_patients_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
            median(per_edge$rho_across_patients_enr, na.rm = TRUE),
            adjustedRandIndex(pm$clusters[pats], pc$clusters[pats]),
            abs(cor(prcomp(pm$X)$x[pats, 1], prcomp(pc$X)$x[pats, 1], method = "spearman"))))
write.csv(summary_tab, file.path(out_dir, "concordance_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
ct <- table(default = pm$pattern_names[as.character(pm$clusters[pats])],
            curated = pc$pattern_names[as.character(pc$clusters[pats])])
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(ct), file.path(out_dir, "pattern_crosstab_default_vs_curated.csv"))

# Step 4d: compare Monte Carlo graph realizations with the kernel networks.
#  - direct edges (raw and normalized), both pipelines
#  - wedges / trust triangles (raw), default pipeline
# Also quantifies graph-to-graph variability: per-edge ICC = share of the
# variance of a single simulated network that is due to between-patient
# differences rather than random graph sampling.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
work_dir <- normalizePath(if (length(args) >= 1) args[1] else ".")
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "pattern_functions.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2) })

res <- file.path(work_dir, "results")
rob <- file.path(res, "04_robustness")
out_dir <- file.path(rob, "montecarlo_vs_kernel")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

read_mc <- function(mc_dir, celltypes, patients, type, file = "Gide_MC.out") {
  r <- compute_results_processing(celltypes = celltypes, patient_names = patients, triangle_type = type,
                                  remove_direction = FALSE, normalized = FALSE,
                                  sim_raw_file = file.path(mc_dir, file),
                                  output_folder = tempdir(), file.name = paste0("tmp_", type, ".csv"))
  list(mean = as.matrix(r$mean), sd = as.matrix(r$sd))
}
dir_label <- function(x) sub("^Dir_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$", "\\1->\\2", x)

compare_direct <- function(pipeline, kernel_rds, mc_dir) {
  k <- readRDS(kernel_rds)
  mc_rds <- readRDS(file.path(mc_dir, "montecarlo_results.rds"))
  set <- mc_rds$settings
  raw <- read_mc(mc_dir, k$celltypes, k$patients, "D")
  colnames(raw$mean) <- colnames(raw$sd) <- dir_label(colnames(raw$mean))
  edges <- colnames(k$dir_prob)
  pats <- intersect(k$patients, rownames(raw$mean))
  m <- raw$mean[pats, edges]; s <- raw$sd[pats, edges]
  tot <- rowSums(m)
  mc_prob <- m / tot
  kp <- k$dir_prob[pats, edges]
  # single-graph variability, expressed on the probability scale
  sd_prob <- s / tot
  between <- apply(mc_prob, 2, var)
  within  <- colMeans(sd_prob^2)
  icc <- between / (between + within)
  per_edge <- data.frame(pipeline = pipeline, edge = edges,
                         median_prob_kernel = apply(kp, 2, median), median_prob_mc = apply(mc_prob, 2, median),
                         rho_across_patients = sapply(edges, function(e) suppressWarnings(cor(kp[, e], mc_prob[, e], method = "spearman"))),
                         median_cv_single_graph = apply(s / m, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE),
                         icc_single_graph = icc, row.names = NULL)
  out <- list(per_edge = per_edge)
  summ <- data.frame(pipeline = pipeline, Ncells = set$Ncells, Ndegree = set$Ndegree, Ngraphs = set$Ngraphs,
                     n_patients = length(pats),
                     median_patient_pearson_prob = median(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(kp[p, ], mc_prob[p, ]))),
                     min_patient_pearson_prob = min(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(kp[p, ], mc_prob[p, ]))),
                     max_abs_diff_prob = max(abs(kp - mc_prob)),
                     median_edge_rho_across_patients_prob = median(per_edge$rho_across_patients, na.rm = TRUE),
                     median_icc_single_graph = median(icc, na.rm = TRUE),
                     frac_edges_icc_gt_0.8 = mean(icc > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (isTRUE(set$norm)) {
    nr <- as.matrix(mc_rds$output$mean); colnames(nr) <- dir_label(colnames(nr))
    rownames(nr) <- to_original_id(rownames(nr))
    nr <- nr[pats, edges]
    ke <- k$dir_norm[pats, edges]
    # edges never realised in either simulation are set to 1 by the package;
    # restrict to edges with nonzero simulated counts
    ok <- m > 0
    summ$median_patient_spearman_enr <- median(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(ke[p, ok[p, ]], nr[p, ok[p, ]], method = "spearman")))
    summ$median_edge_rho_across_patients_enr <- median(sapply(edges, function(e) {
      o <- ok[, e]; if (sum(o) < 10) return(NA); suppressWarnings(cor(ke[o, e], nr[o, e], method = "spearman")) }), na.rm = TRUE)
    C <- k$Cmatrix; rownames(C) <- to_original_id(rownames(C))
    sk <- pattern_sets(list(prob = kp, enr = ke, C = C[pats, ]))
    nr2 <- nr; nr2[!ok] <- NA
    smc <- pattern_sets(list(prob = mc_prob, enr = nr, C = C[pats, ]))
    summ$top10_dominant_overlap <- length(intersect(sk$dominant, smc$dominant)) / 10
    summ$enriched_set_jaccard <- length(intersect(sk$enriched, smc$enriched)) / length(union(sk$enriched, smc$enriched))
    per_edge$median_enr_kernel <- apply(ke, 2, median)
    per_edge$median_enr_mc <- apply(nr2, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    out$per_edge <- per_edge
  }
  out$summary <- summ
  out$scatter <- data.frame(pipeline = pipeline, kernel = as.vector(kp), mc = as.vector(mc_prob))
  out
}

pattern_sets <- function(net) {
  s <- summarise_edges(net$prob, net$enr, top_n = 10, present = edge_presence(net$C, colnames(net$prob)))
  list(summary = s, dominant = head(s$edge[order(-s$median_prob)], 10),
       enriched = s$edge[s$frac_enriched_present >= 0.75 & s$n_present >= 20])
}

results <- list()
for (pl in list(list("default", file.path(res, "02_kernel", "kernel_results.rds"), file.path(rob, "montecarlo_D_main")),
                list("curated", file.path(res, "02b_kernel_curated_prior", "kernel_results.rds"), file.path(rob, "montecarlo_D_curated")))) {
  if (file.exists(file.path(pl[[3]], "montecarlo_results.rds"))) results[[pl[[1]]]] <- compare_direct(pl[[1]], pl[[2]], pl[[3]])
}
summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, `[[`, "summary"))
write.csv(summ, file.path(out_dir, "direct_edges_mc_vs_kernel_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(do.call(rbind, lapply(results, `[[`, "per_edge")), file.path(out_dir, "direct_edges_mc_vs_kernel_per_edge.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, `[[`, "scatter"))
g <- ggplot(sc, aes(kernel, mc)) + geom_abline(colour = "grey50") + geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_sqrt() + scale_y_sqrt() + facet_wrap(~pipeline) +
  labs(x = "kernel edge probability", y = "Monte Carlo edge fraction (mean of graphs)",
       title = "Direct communication: Monte Carlo vs kernel (all patients x edges)") + theme_bw(10)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "direct_edges_mc_vs_kernel.pdf"), g, width = 9, height = 4.5)

# ---- motifs (default pipeline): exact unbundled kernel expectations vs MC
motif_dir <- file.path(rob, "montecarlo_motifs_main")
if (file.exists(file.path(motif_dir, "montecarlo_results.rds"))) {
  k <- readRDS(file.path(res, "02_kernel", "kernel_results.rds"))
  cts <- k$celltypes; n <- length(cts)
  grid <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(n), j = seq_len(n), k = seq_len(n))
  kernel_motif <- function(type) {
    t(sapply(seq_along(k$patients), function(p) {
      K <- k$kernel[, , p]; q <- k$Cmatrix[p, ]
      w <- q[grid$i] * q[grid$j] * q[grid$k]
      v <- if (type == "W") w * K[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)]   # i->j->k
           else w * K[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)] * K[cbind(grid$i, grid$k)]  # i->j, j->k, i->k
      v / sum(v)
    }))
  }
  perms <- list(c(1, 2, 3), c(1, 3, 2), c(2, 1, 3), c(2, 3, 1), c(3, 1, 2), c(3, 2, 1))
  motif_rows <- list(); motif_edge <- list()
  for (type in c("W", "TT")) {
    mc <- read_mc(motif_dir, cts, k$patients, type, file = paste0("Gide_MC_", type, ".out"))
    m <- mc$mean[k$patients, ]; m <- m / rowSums(m)
    kv <- kernel_motif(type)
    # MC tensor index order -> kernel (i, j, k) order: pick the permutation that matches
    arr <- array(t(m), dim = c(n, n, n, nrow(m)))
    fits <- sapply(perms, function(pm) {
      a <- aperm(arr, c(order(pm), 4))
      mm <- t(matrix(a, n^3, nrow(m)))
      median(sapply(seq_len(nrow(m)), function(p) cor(kv[p, ], mm[p, ])))
    })
    best <- perms[[which.max(fits)]]
    a <- aperm(arr, c(order(best), 4)); mm <- t(matrix(a, n^3, nrow(m)))
    lab <- paste(cts[grid$i], cts[grid$j], cts[grid$k], sep = "_")
    colnames(mm) <- colnames(kv) <- lab
    keep <- colMeans(kv) > 1e-4   # motifs carrying non-negligible mass
    motif_rows[[type]] <- data.frame(
      motif = type, Ncells = readRDS(file.path(motif_dir, "montecarlo_results.rds"))$settings$Ncells,
      Ngraphs = readRDS(file.path(motif_dir, "montecarlo_results.rds"))$settings$Ngraphs,
      index_permutation = paste(best, collapse = ""),
      median_patient_pearson = median(sapply(seq_len(nrow(m)), function(p) cor(kv[p, ], mm[p, ]))),
      median_patient_spearman_nonneg = median(sapply(seq_len(nrow(m)), function(p) cor(kv[p, keep], mm[p, keep], method = "spearman"))),
      median_motif_rho_across_patients = median(sapply(which(keep), function(e) suppressWarnings(cor(kv[, e], mm[, e], method = "spearman"))), na.rm = TRUE),
      top20_overlap = length(intersect(names(sort(apply(kv, 2, median), TRUE))[1:20],
                                       names(sort(apply(mm, 2, median), TRUE))[1:20])) / 20)
  }
  write.csv(do.call(rbind, motif_rows), file.path(out_dir, "motifs_mc_vs_kernel_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  print(do.call(rbind, motif_rows))
}
print(summ)

    t(sapply(seq_along(k$patients), function(p) {
      K <- k$kernel[, , p]; q <- k$Cmatrix[p, ]
      w <- q[grid$i] * q[grid$j] * q[grid$k]

           else w * K[cbind(grid$i, grid$j)] * K[cbind(grid$j, grid$k)] * K[cbind(grid$i, grid$k)]  # i->j, j->k, i->k

    }))
  }

      a <- aperm(arr, c(order(pm), 4))
      mm <- t(matrix(a, n^3, nrow(m)))

    })

      median_patient_spearman_nonneg = median(sapply(seq_len(nrow(m)), function(p) cor(kv[p, keep], mm[p, keep], method = "spearman"))),

                                       names(sort(apply(mm, 2, median), TRUE))[1:20])) / 20)
  }

read_mc <- function(mc_dir, celltypes, patients, type, file = "Gide_MC.out") {
  r <- compute_results_processing(celltypes = celltypes, patient_names = patients, triangle_type = type,
                                  remove_direction = FALSE, normalized = FALSE,
                                  sim_raw_file = file.path(mc_dir, file),
                                  output_folder = tempdir(), file.name = paste0("tmp_", type, ".csv"))
  list(mean = as.matrix(r$mean), sd = as.matrix(r$sd))
}
dir_label <- function(x) sub("^Dir_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$", "\\1->\\2", x)

compare_direct <- function(pipeline, kernel_rds, mc_dir) {
  k <- readRDS(kernel_rds)
  mc_rds <- readRDS(file.path(mc_dir, "montecarlo_results.rds"))
  set <- mc_rds$settings
  raw <- read_mc(mc_dir, k$celltypes, k$patients, "D")
  colnames(raw$mean) <- colnames(raw$sd) <- dir_label(colnames(raw$mean))
  edges <- colnames(k$dir_prob)
  pats <- intersect(k$patients, rownames(raw$mean))
  m <- raw$mean[pats, edges]; s <- raw$sd[pats, edges]
  tot <- rowSums(m)
  mc_prob <- m / tot
  kp <- k$dir_prob[pats, edges]
  # single-graph variability, expressed on the probability scale
  sd_prob <- s / tot
  between <- apply(mc_prob, 2, var)
  within  <- colMeans(sd_prob^2)
  icc <- between / (between + within)
  per_edge <- data.frame(pipeline = pipeline, edge = edges,
                         median_prob_kernel = apply(kp, 2, median), median_prob_mc = apply(mc_prob, 2, median),
                         rho_across_patients = sapply(edges, function(e) suppressWarnings(cor(kp[, e], mc_prob[, e], method = "spearman"))),
                         median_cv_single_graph = apply(s / m, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE),
                         icc_single_graph = icc, row.names = NULL)
  out <- list(per_edge = per_edge)
  summ <- data.frame(pipeline = pipeline, Ncells = set$Ncells, Ndegree = set$Ndegree, Ngraphs = set$Ngraphs,
                     n_patients = length(pats),
                     median_patient_pearson_prob = median(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(kp[p, ], mc_prob[p, ]))),
                     min_patient_pearson_prob = min(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(kp[p, ], mc_prob[p, ]))),
                     max_abs_diff_prob = max(abs(kp - mc_prob)),
                     median_edge_rho_across_patients_prob = median(per_edge$rho_across_patients, na.rm = TRUE),
                     median_icc_single_graph = median(icc, na.rm = TRUE),
                     frac_edges_icc_gt_0.8 = mean(icc > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (isTRUE(set$norm)) {
    nr <- as.matrix(mc_rds$output$mean); colnames(nr) <- dir_label(colnames(nr))
    rownames(nr) <- to_original_id(rownames(nr))
    nr <- nr[pats, edges]
    ke <- k$dir_norm[pats, edges]
    # edges never realised in either simulation are set to 1 by the package;
    # restrict to edges with nonzero simulated counts
    ok <- m > 0
    summ$median_patient_spearman_enr <- median(sapply(pats, function(p) cor(ke[p, ok[p, ]], nr[p, ok[p, ]], method = "spearman")))
    summ$median_edge_rho_across_patients_enr <- median(sapply(edges, function(e) {
      o <- ok[, e]; if (sum(o) < 10) return(NA); suppressWarnings(cor(ke[o, e], nr[o, e], method = "spearman")) }), na.rm = TRUE)
    C <- k$Cmatrix; rownames(C) <- to_original_id(rownames(C))
    sk <- pattern_sets(list(prob = kp, enr = ke, C = C[pats, ]))
    nr2 <- nr; nr2[!ok] <- NA
    smc <- pattern_sets(list(prob = mc_prob, enr = nr, C = C[pats, ]))
    summ$top10_dominant_overlap <- length(intersect(sk$dominant, smc$dominant)) / 10
    summ$enriched_set_jaccard <- length(intersect(sk$enriched, smc$enriched)) / length(union(sk$enriched, smc$enriched))
    per_edge$median_enr_kernel <- apply(ke, 2, median)
    per_edge$median_enr_mc <- apply(nr2, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    out$per_edge <- per_edge
  }
  out$summary <- summ
  out$scatter <- data.frame(pipeline = pipeline, kernel = as.vector(kp), mc = as.vector(mc_prob))
  out
}

pattern_sets <- function(net) {
  s <- summarise_edges(net$prob, net$enr, top_n = 10, present = edge_presence(net$C, colnames(net$prob)))
  list(summary = s, dominant = head(s$edge[order(-s$median_prob)], 10),

# Step 4b: robustness of the communication patterns to input/parameter
# perturbations, for either pipeline:
#   main    = package default (prepare_input_files: quanTIseq + NNLS profiles + OmniPath)
#   curated = original RaCInG curated cell-type compatibility (see 01b)
# Every perturbed run rebuilds the RaCInG inputs end-to-end and recomputes the
# kernel networks, then is compared with the baseline at three levels:
# cohort-level patterns, patient-level networks and patient groupings.
# Usage: Rscript 04b_perturbations.R <work_dir> <main|curated> [n_rep=20] [ncores=6]
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
work_dir <- normalizePath(args[1])
pipeline <- args[2]
n_rep  <- if (length(args) >= 3) as.integer(args[3]) else 20
ncores <- if (length(args) >= 4) as.integer(args[4]) else 6
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "pattern_functions.R"))
source(file.path(work_dir, "scripts", "helpers_curated.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(parallel); library(mclust); library(ggplot2); library(pheatmap) })

res <- file.path(work_dir, "results")
paths <- switch(pipeline,
  main    = list(kernel = file.path(res, "02_kernel", "kernel_results.rds"),
                 patterns = file.path(res, "03_patterns", "patient_patterns.rds")),
  curated = list(kernel = file.path(res, "02b_kernel_curated_prior", "kernel_results.rds"),
                 patterns = file.path(res, "03b_patterns_curated_prior", "patient_patterns.rds")))
out_dir <- file.path(res, "04_robustness", paste0("perturbations_", pipeline))
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
scratch <- file.path(tempdir(), "racing_variants"); dir.create(scratch, showWarnings = FALSE)

base_k   <- readRDS(paths$kernel)
base_pat <- readRDS(paths$patterns)
base <- list(prob = base_k$dir_prob, enr = base_k$dir_norm,
             C = `rownames<-`(base_k$Cmatrix, to_original_id(rownames(base_k$Cmatrix))))
best_k <- base_pat$best_k
base_clusters <- base_pat$clusters
base_pc1 <- prcomp(base_pat$X)$x[, 1]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
network_from_input <- function(input) {
  kr <- compute_kernel(input$Lmatrix, input$Rmatrix, input$Cmatrix, input$LRmatrix, normalize = TRUE)
  cts <- input$celltypes
  prob <- directed_edge_probs(kr$kernel, input$Cmatrix, cts)
  enr <- compute_kernel_features(kr$kernel, unifKernel = kr$kernel_norm, celltypes = cts,
                                 communication_type = "D", bundle = FALSE, norm = TRUE,
                                 patient_names = rownames(prob), zero_threshold = 1.01)
  colnames(enr) <- sub("^Dir_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$", "\\1->\\2", colnames(enr))
  C <- input$Cmatrix; rownames(C) <- to_original_id(rownames(C))
  list(prob = prob, enr = as.matrix(enr[, colnames(prob)]), C = C)
}

pattern_sets <- function(net) {
  s <- summarise_edges(net$prob, net$enr, top_n = 10, present = edge_presence(net$C, colnames(net$prob)))
  het <- s[s$sender != s$receiver, ]
  list(summary = s,
       dominant = head(s$edge[order(-s$median_prob)], 10),
       dominant_hetero = head(het$edge[order(-het$median_prob)], 10),
       enriched = s$edge[s$frac_enriched_present >= 0.75 & s$n_present >= 20])
}
base_sets <- pattern_sets(base)

jaccard <- function(a, b) if (length(union(a, b)) == 0) NA else length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
med_rho <- function(A, B, margin) {
  v <- if (margin == 1) sapply(seq_len(nrow(A)), function(i) cor(A[i, ], B[i, ], method = "spearman"))
       else sapply(seq_len(ncol(A)), function(j) suppressWarnings(cor(A[, j], B[, j], method = "spearman")))
  median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
}

compare_to_base <- function(net, id, type) {
  pats <- intersect(rownames(net$prob), rownames(base$prob))
  edges <- intersect(colnames(net$prob), colnames(base$prob))
  sets <- pattern_sets(net)
  sv <- sets$summary[match(edges, sets$summary$edge), ]
  sb <- base_sets$summary[match(edges, base_sets$summary$edge), ]
  X <- enrichment_matrix(net$enr[pats, edges])
  cc <- consensus_cluster(X, ks = best_k, reps = 100, p_item = 0.8)
  cl <- cc$clusters[[as.character(best_k)]]
  bc <- base_clusters[pats]
  # clusterwise stability (Hennig 2007): best Jaccard match per baseline cluster
  cw <- sapply(sort(unique(base_clusters)), function(c) {
    a <- names(bc)[bc == c]
    if (length(a) == 0) return(NA)
    max(sapply(unique(cl), function(d) jaccard(a, names(cl)[cl == d])))
  })
  metrics <- data.frame(
    run = id, perturbation = type, n_patients = length(pats), n_edges = length(edges),
    n_celltypes = length(unique(split_edge(colnames(net$prob))[, 1])),
    cohort_rho_prob = cor(sv$median_prob, sb$median_prob, method = "spearman"),
    cohort_rho_enrichment = cor(sv$median_enrichment, sb$median_enrichment, method = "spearman"),
    top10_dominant_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant, base_sets$dominant)) / 10,
    top10_dominant_hetero_overlap = length(intersect(sets$dominant_hetero, base_sets$dominant_hetero)) / 10,
    enriched_set_jaccard = jaccard(sets$enriched, base_sets$enriched),
    patient_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 1),
    patient_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 1),
    edge_across_patients_rho_prob = med_rho(net$prob[pats, edges], base$prob[pats, edges], 2),
    edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment = med_rho(net$enr[pats, edges], base$enr[pats, edges], 2),
    pattern_ARI = adjustedRandIndex(cl, bc),
    PC1_abs_rho = abs(cor(prcomp(X)$x[, 1], base_pc1[pats], method = "spearman"))
  )
  for (c in seq_along(cw)) metrics[[paste0("jaccard_P", c)]] <- cw[c]
  list(metrics = metrics, dominant = sets$dominant, dominant_hetero = sets$dominant_hetero,
       enriched = sets$enriched)
}

add_noise_expr <- function(tpm, sd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lg <- log2(tpm + 1) + matrix(rnorm(length(tpm), 0, sd), nrow(tpm))
  t2 <- 2^pmax(lg, 0) - 1
  t2 <- sweep(t2, 2, colSums(t2), "/") * 1e6
  dimnames(t2) <- dimnames(tpm); t2
}
add_noise_frac <- function(f, sdlog, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  f2 <- as.matrix(f) * exp(matrix(rnorm(length(as.matrix(f)), 0, sdlog), nrow(f)))
  f2 <- f2 / rowSums(f2)
  if (is.data.frame(f)) f2 <- as.data.frame(f2)
  f2
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ variants
tpm <- load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = TRUE)
jobs <- list()
reps <- seq_len(n_rep)

if (pipeline == "main") {
  deconv <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  omni <- readRDS(file.path(tools::R_user_dir("RaCInG", "cache"), "curated_omni_network.rds"))
  bi <- function(id, t, d, ...) { o <- file.path(scratch, id); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE)); build_inputs(t, d, o, ...) }
  jobs[["expr_threshold_5"]]  <- list(type = "expr_threshold = 5 TPM", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, expr_threshold = 5))
  jobs[["expr_threshold_20"]] <- list(type = "expr_threshold = 20 TPM", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, expr_threshold = 20))
  jobs[["fun_LR_prod"]]       <- list(type = "fun_LR = prod", f = function(id) bi(id, tpm, deconv, fun_LR = prod))
  jobs[["no_TPM_rescaling"]]  <- list(type = "no TPM re-closure", f = function(id) bi(id, load_tpm(work_dir, rescale = FALSE), deconv))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]]    <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) {
    keep <- setdiff(colnames(tpm), "Pt8_PD1_PRE"); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      bi(id, tpm, add_noise_frac(deconv, 0.3, 100 + r)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      bi(id, t2, run_quantiseq(t2, o)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); bi(id, tpm, deconv, cc_network = omni[sort(sample(nrow(omni), round(0.8 * nrow(omni)))), ]) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); keep <- sort(sample(colnames(tpm), round(0.8 * ncol(tpm)))); bi(id, tpm[, keep], deconv[keep, ]) })
  }
} else {
  prior <- curated_prior()
  q <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01_inputs", "quantiseq_fractions.rds"))
  epic <- readRDS(file.path(res, "01b_curated_prior_inputs", "epic_fractions.rds"))
  base_input <- build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic)
  subset_input <- function(inp, keep) { i <- match(keep, rownames(inp$Cmatrix))
    inp$Cmatrix <- inp$Cmatrix[i, , drop = FALSE]; inp$LRmatrix <- inp$LRmatrix[, , i, drop = FALSE]; inp }
  jobs[["tumor_as_quantiseq_other"]] <- list(type = "Tumor = quanTIseq other", f = function(id) build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, tumor_mode = "other"))
  jobs[["drop_8_PD1_PRE"]] <- list(type = "drop low-quality sample", f = function(id) subset_input(base_input, setdiff(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), "Pt8_PD1_PRE")))
  for (r in reps) {
    jobs[[sprintf("frac_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cell-fraction noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      inp <- base_input; inp$Cmatrix <- add_noise_frac(inp$Cmatrix, 0.3, 100 + r); inp })
    jobs[[sprintf("expr_noise_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "expression noise", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      t2 <- add_noise_expr(tpm, 0.3, 200 + r)
      o <- file.path(scratch, paste0(id, "_q")); dir.create(o); on.exit(unlink(o, recursive = TRUE))
      q2 <- run_quantiseq(t2, o); build_curated_input(prior, t2, q2, run_epic(t2)) })
    jobs[[sprintf("lr_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "LR prior 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(300 + r); build_curated_input(prior, tpm, q, epic, keep_pairs = sort(sample(nrow(prior$pairs), round(0.8 * nrow(prior$pairs))))) })
    jobs[[sprintf("patient_subsample_%02d", r)]] <- list(type = "cohort 80% subsample", r = r, f = function(id, r) {
      set.seed(400 + r); subset_input(base_input, sort(sample(rownames(base_input$Cmatrix), round(0.8 * nrow(base_input$Cmatrix))))) })
  }
}

cat(length(jobs), "perturbed runs on", ncores, "cores\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
out <- mclapply(names(jobs), function(id) {
  j <- jobs[[id]]
  tryCatch({
    inp <- if (is.null(j$r)) j$f(id) else j$f(id, j$r)
    compare_to_base(network_from_input(inp), id, j$type)
  }, error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e), run = id))
}, mc.cores = ncores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
names(out) <- names(jobs)
cat("Finished in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")
# mclapply returns NULL/try-error for workers that died (e.g. out of memory)
failed <- vapply(out, function(o) !is.list(o) || !is.null(o$error), logical(1))
out[failed] <- lapply(names(out)[failed], function(id) if (is.list(out[[id]])) out[[id]] else list(error = "worker died", run = id))
if (all(failed)) stop("All perturbed runs failed.")
if (any(failed)) { cat("FAILED runs:\n"); print(sapply(out[failed], `[[`, "error")) }
out <- out[!failed]
saveRDS(out, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_runs.rds"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ summaries
metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(out, `[[`, "metrics"))
write.csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
num <- setdiff(names(metrics), c("run", "perturbation"))
summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(metrics, metrics$perturbation), function(d) {
  data.frame(perturbation = d$perturbation[1], n_runs = nrow(d),
             t(sapply(num, function(m) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f-%.2f]", median(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                min(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE), max(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE)))),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(summ, file.path(out_dir, "perturbation_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# per-pattern retention: how often each baseline pattern survives a perturbation
retention <- function(field, base_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(out, sapply(out, function(o) o$metrics$perturbation)), function(runs) {
    data.frame(perturbation = runs[[1]]$metrics$perturbation, edge = base_list,
               retained = sapply(base_list, function(e) mean(sapply(runs, function(o) e %in% o[[field]]))))
  }))
}
ret <- rbind(cbind(set = "dominant (top 10 by probability)", retention("dominant", base_sets$dominant)),
             cbind(set = "dominant heterotypic (top 10)", retention("dominant_hetero", base_sets$dominant_hetero)),
             cbind(set = "commonly enriched (>=75% of patients)", retention("enriched", base_sets$enriched)))
write.csv(ret, file.path(out_dir, "pattern_retention.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (s in unique(ret$set)) {
  d <- ret[ret$set == s, ]
  m <- tapply(d$retained, list(d$edge, d$perturbation), mean)
  m <- m[order(-rowMeans(m)), , drop = FALSE]
  pheatmap(100 * m, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.0f",
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkgreen"))(100), breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
           main = paste0("% of perturbed runs retaining baseline pattern: ", s), angle_col = 45,
           filename = file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("retention_%s.pdf", gsub("[^a-z]+", "_", tolower(s)))),
           width = 8, height = 0.3 * nrow(m) + 2.5)
}

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_prob",
                                "patient_rho_enrichment", "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment",
                                "enriched_set_jaccard", "top10_dominant_hetero_overlap", "pattern_ARI"),
  function(m) data.frame(metric = m, perturbation = metrics$perturbation, value = metrics[[m]])))
g <- ggplot(long, aes(x = perturbation, y = value)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) + facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(0, min(long$value, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = sprintf("Agreement with baseline (%s pipeline)", pipeline)) +
  theme_bw(9) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "agreement_with_baseline.pdf"), g, width = 13, height = 7)

# cohort-level patient bootstrap of the baseline (sampling uncertainty of the
# cohort summaries, independent of input perturbations)
set.seed(7)
B <- 1000
boot <- replicate(B, {
  idx <- sample(nrow(base$prob), replace = TRUE)
  nb <- list(prob = base$prob[idx, ], enr = base$enr[idx, ], C = base$C[idx, ])
  rownames(nb$prob) <- rownames(nb$enr) <- rownames(nb$C) <- paste0("b", seq_along(idx))
  s <- pattern_sets(nb)
  c(dominant = list(s$dominant), enriched = list(s$enriched),
    med = list(setNames(s$summary$median_prob, s$summary$edge)),
    fenr = list(setNames(s$summary$frac_enriched_present, s$summary$edge)))
}, simplify = FALSE)
edges_all <- colnames(base$prob)
bt <- data.frame(edge = edges_all,
  p_dominant_top10 = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$dominant))),
  p_commonly_enriched = sapply(edges_all, function(e) mean(sapply(boot, function(b) e %in% b$enriched))),
  median_prob_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.025)),
  median_prob_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$med[[e]]), 0.975)),
  frac_enriched_ci_low = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
  frac_enriched_ci_high = sapply(edges_all, function(e) quantile(sapply(boot, function(b) b$fenr[[e]]), 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
  row.names = NULL)
bt <- merge(base_sets$summary[, c("edge", "median_prob", "frac_enriched_present", "n_present")], bt, by = "edge")
bt <- bt[order(-bt$p_dominant_top10, -bt$p_commonly_enriched), ]
write.csv(bt, file.path(out_dir, "edge_bootstrap_cohort.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(summ[, c("perturbation", "n_runs", "cohort_rho_prob", "cohort_rho_enrichment", "patient_rho_enrichment",
               "edge_across_patients_rho_enrichment", "enriched_set_jaccard", "pattern_ARI")], right = FALSE)
